title: Glancing Blows
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|q_where = id="glancing_blows_keystone2693"}}

'''Glancing Blows''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] which grants doubles both Attack and Spell [[Block]] chance while causing you to take 65% of the blocked hit's damage.

==Mechanics==
{{Main|Blocking#Taking damage from blocked hits}}

==Location==
The keystone is located on the middle layer of the west part of the tree, between the Marauder and Templar starting areas.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.12.0|
* Now causes you to take 65% of Damage from Blocked Hits (from 50%). It has been moved so as to make it more difficult to acquire via a [[Thread of Hope]] jewel.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* Timeless Jewel Keystone passives have become a popular feature for many builds, but are prohibitively difficult to acquire (especially without trade). We've moved some of the most build-defining Keystones out of the Timeless Jewels and into the tree itself. These Keystones have been added to the tree: [[The Agnostic]], Glancing Blows, [[Supreme Ego]], [[Wind Dancer]] and [[Eternal Youth]].
* Timeless Jewels -- New keystones have been added to replace the five that are now available on the passive skill tree. The new ones are: [[The Traitor (keystone passive)|The Traitor]], [[Supreme Ostentation]], [[Chainbreaker]], [[Transcendence (keystone passive)|Transcendence]], [[Immortal Ambition]]. Existing Timeless Jewels will retain the old keystones, but if you reroll them with a Divine Orb they will be able to reveal these new keystones.
}}
